title: Don't Give Up On God | A Prayer For When You're Tired Of Trying (Galatians 6:9)
description:
Don't give up on God. A word and a prayer for when you're tired of trying and thinking about quitting.

Elijah wanted to quit. Paul was knocked down and got back up. Scripture for worn-out people, and a prayer for strength to stay in the field until the due season.

"And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not." Galatians 6:9 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): 1 Kings 19:7, Galatians 6:9, Isaiah 40:29, 2 Corinthians 4:8-9, 2 Corinthians 4:16-17, Hebrews 12:1-2, Hebrews 10:35-36, 2 Timothy 4:7.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
